name: Skeletal Knight
description: An undead knight wielding iron equipment
fullDescription: A reanimated knight bound to serve the Elemental Faction. Wears full iron armor and wields an iron sword with a shield.

name: Zombiefied Knight
description: A powerful zombified warrior in diamond armor
fullDescription: A more powerful undead knight covered in diamond armor. Much stronger than its skeletal counterpart.

name: Corrupt Knight
description: A knight corrupted by void energy
fullDescription: Knights corrupted by the Void, serving the Corrupted King. They wield diamond equipment and inflict wither on their targets.

name: Corrupted Undead
description: Basic corrupted minions serving the void
fullDescription: The most basic servants of the Corrupted King. These undead warriors serve as the bulk of the void army.

name: Gumm-Gumm Goblin
description: Small but vicious goblin warriors
fullDescription: Small goblin creatures that serve the Gumm-Gumm army. They attack in swarms to overwhelm their enemies.

name: Gumm-Gumm Berserker
description: Fierce berserker warriors of the Gumm-Gumm
fullDescription: Powerful warriors who enter a berserker rage, becoming even more dangerous in combat.

name: Flame Trickster
description: Agile fire-wielding minion of Magmar
fullDescription: A servant of Magmar Elemental who uses fire and mobility to harass enemies. Can teleport and inflict burning.

name: Frost Trickster
description: Swift ice-wielding servant of the Frost Elemental
fullDescription: A more powerful servant of the Frost Elemental. Uses ice magic and mobility to slow and overwhelm enemies.

name: Infernal Phantom
description: Ethereal minion of Infernax the Ancient
fullDescription: Spectral warriors summoned by Infernax. They teleport around the battlefield and drain the life from their enemies.

name: Undead Miner
description: A zombified miner who summons bandit reinforcements
fullDescription: Once a humble miner, now an undead creature that leads bands of bandits through old mining tunnels.

name: Corrupt Trickster
description: A devious corrupted boss who terrorizes with mobility and summons
fullDescription: A corrupted warrior who has mastered void magic, using teleportation and minion summoning to overwhelm enemies.

sections.title: Strategy
content: Very fast movement (0.45 speed) - difficult to escape

name: Bandit
description: Common bandits that raid mining operations
fullDescription: Criminal gangs that lurk in caves and attack miners. Come in both melee and ranged variants.

sections.title: Variants
content: Bandit - Zombie type, melee with axe
Decayed Bandit - Skeleton type, ranged with bow

name: Skeletal Minion
description: Weak skeleton minion summoned by bosses
fullDescription: Basic skeleton summoned by the Skeleton King to overwhelm enemies with numbers.

name: Zomboid Minion
description: Weak zombie minion summoned by bosses
fullDescription: Basic zombie summoned by the Zombie King to overwhelm enemies with numbers.

name: Slime Variants
description: Various sizes of slimes serving King Slime
fullDescription: Slimes of various sizes summoned by King Slime. Range from tiny to giant, with health scaling by size.

name: Spawn of the King
description: Elite slime spawn of King Slime
fullDescription: Larger and more dangerous slimes directly spawned by King Slime. Can summon smaller slimes.

name: Changeling Illusion
description: Deceptive illusion created by the Changeling
fullDescription: A fake copy created by the Changeling to confuse and distract enemies. Fades after a short time.

sections.title: Abilities
content: Illusion Fade - Disappears after short duration

name: Angor's Shadow Clone
description: Shadow duplicate of Angor Rot
fullDescription: A shadow clone created by Angor Rot to attack and confuse enemies. Fades after a period of time.

name: Spirit of Bular
description: Spectral form of Bular summoned by Gunmar
fullDescription: The spirit of Bular the Butcher, summoned by his father Gunmar at 50% health. Retains some of Bular's deadly abilities.

name: Spirit of Angor Rot
description: Spectral form of Angor Rot summoned by Gunmar
fullDescription: The spirit of Angor Rot, summoned by Gunmar at 50% health. Retains the deadly shadow assassin abilities.
